atAGlance: Thịt kho tiêu is pork braised with fish sauce caramel and plenty of black pepper. It is darker, sharper, and less sweet-feeling than the coconut-water egg version.
whatItIs: Thịt kho tiêu is pork braised in fish-sauce caramel with black pepper. It is darker, pepperier, and more rice-hungry than a simple pork plate.
howToEnjoy: Spoon a small amount of sauce onto rice, then add more only if you want the peppery salty-sweet flavor stronger.
howLocalsOrder: Thịt kho tiêu is pork braised with black pepper, so order it with rice and ask for less pepper if you are heat-sensitive. The point is salty caramel depth, not a separate chili burn.
worthKnowing: Kho dishes are Vietnamese braises, often built from fish sauce and caramelized sugar. Tiêu tells you this one leans into pepper.
goodToKnow: Tiêu means pepper. Order rice with it because the peppery caramel sauce is too concentrated to eat alone.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần thịt kho tiêu.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of pork braised with pepper.
